text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Despite a valiant effort, Mejiro McQueen 
suffered a defeat at the hands of Mejiro 
Ryan.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
However, she couldn't stay downcast 
forever. Fired up, she resolved to rebuild 
and retrain herself.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Looking at her back, Mejiro Ryan thanked 
her for giving it her all and voiced her 
firm resolve never to lose next time.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And... her next target was the Tenno Sho 
(Spring). Mejiro McQueen was eager to show 
the culmination of her efforts.
